protocol.candidates: 1 held-out positive + 100 uniformly sampled titles the member had not rated before t; fixed seed, identical for every model

temporal_recommendation.note: Backbone is shared by F0/F1/Fctrl (the variants only change the ranker), so this task is identical across them.

negation_diagnostic.note: Averaged word vectors keep the word 'intense' in the query vector; negation is not represented.

motif_aggregate_dev.definition:
Comparable contexts: explicit-intent cases where F0 ranks a grade-0 Crime/Thriller title A above the
best-ranked grade-2 title B and the behaviour component favours A (same structure as the primary case).
motif_aggregate_dev.aggregation_note: Mean of per-prediction S(m) across comparable cases; bootstrap resamples MEMBERS (n_boot=2000). This aggregation is our extension, not part of CATGX.

cold_first_call_ms.note: first call in a fresh process; includes spaCy query encoding and torch warm-up

agent_orchestration_case_tools.note: 4 case-level tools; envelope/provenance overhead = total - sum_tool_ms

latency.cache_status: no result caches used in these timings; query vectors are memoised after first use (warm)
